name: vocdoni-contributing
description: Vocdoni's rules for what the agent writes on the git host: tying each change to an issue (found, or opened before the PR), who it introduces itself as, length and structure for PR/MR descriptions, issues, reviews and commits, and how to post a review as a review. A SessionStart hook injects the same rules into every Claude Code session, so they apply even when a PR is one step of a larger task.
